title: Logic and the Foundations of Game and Decision Theory (LOFT 7)
bookshelves: Category: Economics, Finance, Business and Management
summary: This volume collects together revised papers originally presented at the 7th Conference on Logic and the Foundations of Game and Decision Theory (LOFT 2006). LOFT is a key venue for presenting research at the intersection of logic, economics and computer science, and the present collection gives a lively and wide-ranging view of an exciting and rapidly growing area.
